value: A budget is telling your money where to go instead of wondering where it went. Check your Finance section to set your monthly goal!
Try to save at least 20% of your income. Start by building an emergency fund for 3-6 months of expenses.
Logging every expense, no matter how small, is the first step to financial freedom. It builds awareness of where your money leaks.
I can't give specific investment advice, but generally, diversify your portfolio and think long-term. Stay consistent!
Focus on paying off high-interest debt first. This is often called the 'Avalanche Method' and saves you the most money.
You can log an expense by saying 'Log [amount] expense'. For example, 'Log 50 expense'. You can also go to the Finance section and tap the '+' button.
In the Finance section, start by setting a monthly budget. Then, every time you spend money, just tell me 'Log [Amount] expense' or add it manually. I'll help you track your burn rate!
